# Gymbell
> AI-powered workout tracking for iPhone and Apple Watch

Gymbell is a workout tracker with smart progressive overload coaching, body balance analysis, Apple Watch companion mode, and AI-generated training programs. Available on the App Store with a 1-month free trial.

## Key Features
- Smart NEXT UP: predicts which muscle group to train next based on your history
- Progressive overload hints and in-session coach suggestions
- Apple Watch companion mode with real-time set sync
- Body balance tracking across 7 major muscle groups
- AI-generated multi-week training programs (Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini)
- Strength charts and estimated 1RM trend tracking
- Local storage via SwiftData — no account, no cloud, no data harvesting

## Pricing
- Monthly: $2.99/month (after 1-month free trial)
- Lifetime: $44.99 one-time purchase
- Family Sharing included in both plans
